summary: In the subway station, an old man sits hunched in a corner, nursing from a bottle of Thunderbird. A phone begins to ring, and Neo leads Trinity and Morpheus over the turnstiles toward a graffiti-covered phone booth. Neo urges Morpheus to go first; Morpheus enters the booth, answers the phone, and then disappears, leaving the phone dropping and dangling by its cord. The old man, lost in shadow, watches this, and his eyes grow wide, glowing white in the dark.

what_changes.before: Present and physical, answering the ringing phone in the booth
what_changes.after: Gone — having exited, leaving only the dangling phone behind
what_changes.evidence: Morpheus gets in and answers the phone. Lost in the shadow, the old man watches as Morpheus disappears, the phone dropping, dangling by its cord.

what_changes.before: A passive, unnoticed drunk hunched in the shadows
what_changes.after: A witness who sees the impossible, his eyes glowing white
what_changes.evidence: His eyes grow wide, glowing white in the dark.

event_hint.one_line: The fleeing crew reaches a subway exit phone, and one by one they leave the Matrix.

uncertain: Whether the old man is an ordinary bystander or something more, given his glowing white eyes.
Whether Neo and Trinity also exit in this scene or follow after it ends.
